metadata.question: Does Pacific Palisades have higher tropospheric Nitrogen dioxide levels on January 9, 2025 than on January 12, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Date: January 9, 2025 vs January 12, 2025 - Location: Pacific Palisades, California (approximately 34.05°N, 118.53°W) 2. Masking strategy: - For NO2, we should use the qa_value band to filter for good quality pixels (qa_value >= 0.75 is recommended) - This is about actual NO2 levels, not about clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Zero or very low NO2 is valid (it's a real atmospheric measurement) - Null/None means calculation failed (C3) - No images means C1 - No valid pixels after QA masking means C2 - Compare mean NO2 values for both dates ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Pacific Palisades location const palisades = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.53, 34.05]); const region = palisades.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer // 2. Define date ranges const date1_start = '2025-01-09'; const date1_end = '2025-01-10'; const date2_start = '2025-01-12'; const date2_end = '2025-01-13'; // 3. Load Sentinel-5P NO2 data const s5p = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2'); // Filter for Jan 9, 2025 let col1 = s5p .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .filterBounds(region) .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']); // Filter for Jan 12, 2025 let col2 = s5p .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .filterBounds(region) .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 9 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Jan 12 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Apply quality mask and get mean NO2 function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').updateMask(mask); } const img1 = col1.map(maskQuality).mean(); const img2 = col2.map(maskQuality).mean(); // 5. Calculate statistics const stats1 = await img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const no2_jan9 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count1 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; const no2_jan12 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count2 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Jan 9: NO2=${no2_jan9}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Jan 12: NO2=${no2_jan12}, Pixels=${count2}`); // 6. Validation if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (no2_jan9 === null || no2_jan12 === null || isNaN(no2_jan9) || isNaN(no2_jan12)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare and answer if (no2_jan9 > no2_jan12) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
